description: This file implements classes and methods related to AWC (possibly 'Application Widget Controller' or similar), including an AWCStateChangeNotifier for managing listeners and notifying state changes, as well as an AWCListener class that responds to window and state change notifications within an application process context.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages a list of listeners interested in state changes of AWC applications and notifies them of changes.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Receives notifications about window state changes and application state changes, delegates notification to AWCStateChangeNotifier.

methods.name: void addListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Registers a new listener to receive AWC state change notifications. Prevents duplicates.

methods.name: void removeListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Unregisters a listener from receiving AWC state change notifications.

methods.name: void notify(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of an application state change, including request ID, app state, status, and process ID.

methods.name: void notifyWindowChange(int window_id VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,awc::AWCClient::awc_window_state_t window_state VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,unsigned int pid VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED)
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling window change notifications; currently empty.

methods.name: void notifyStateChange(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Handles application state change events by logging and forwarding notifications.

methods.name: void notifyServiceReady()
methods.description: Placeholder method indicating the service is ready; no current action.
